subject: [RFC PATCH v2 17/18] mm/shmem: read without folio references

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the shmem_file_read_iter function to take a reference on every folio it reads, which can cause small reads of one tmpfs file from many CPUs to bounce the folio's refcount. To fix this issue, the patch introduces a new function called filemap_read_rcu that copies data from the page cache without taking any references. This function is used in place of shmem_file_read_iter for small reads, allowing multiple CPUs to read from the same tmpfs file simultaneously without causing reference count bounces.
